injuries.name: Caleb Wilson
injuries.detail: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Smith
injuries.detail: Smith (finger) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against Cleveland.

injuries.name: Tobe Awaka
injuries.detail: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Cavaliers.

injuries.name: Evan Mobley
injuries.detail: Mobley (toe) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Chicago.

injuries.name: Peyton Watson
injuries.detail: Watson (abdominal soreness) is questionable to play in Monday's game against the Bulls.

injuries.name: Sam Merrill
injuries.detail: Merrill (elbow) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bulls.

injuries.name: Jaylon Tyson
injuries.detail: Tyson (ankle) is questionable for Monday's game against the Bulls.

injuries.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
injuries.detail: Tomlin is set to miss several weeks with a lower back stress reaction, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Stephen Curry
injuries.detail: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

injuries.name: Gui Santos
injuries.detail: Santos is questionable for Monday's game against New Orleans due to right ankle inflammation.

injuries.name: Brandon Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

injuries.name: Fred VanVleet
injuries.detail: VanVleet (right knee injury management) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Marcus Smart
injuries.detail: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Clint Capela
injuries.detail: Capela (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Washington.

injuries.name: Julian Phillips
injuries.detail: Phillips (illness) is available for Wednesday's game against Dallas.

injuries.name: Ty Jerome
injuries.detail: Jerome (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Zach Edey
injuries.detail: Edey (ankle) is questionable for Monday's game against Washington.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.detail: Pippen (back) remains out for Wednesday's game against Denver, Michael Wallace of the Grizzlies' official site reports.

injuries.name: GG Jackson

injuries.name: Isaiah Stewart
injuries.detail: Stewart is questionable for Monday's game against the Wizards due to an illness.

injuries.name: Quinten Post
injuries.detail: Post (concussion) is questionable for Monday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Richie Saunders
injuries.detail: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Pelle Larsson
injuries.detail: Larsson (illness) is questionable to play in Monday's game against the Rockets.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.detail: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jaylen Clark
injuries.detail: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

injuries.name: Trey Murphy III

injuries.name: Dejounte Murray
injuries.detail: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Bennedict Mathurin

injuries.name: Bryce McGowens
injuries.detail: McGowens (elbow) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Trendon Watford
injuries.detail: Watford (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.detail: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.detail: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.detail: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.detail: Embiid (right foot injury management) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.detail: Barlow (back) participated in Thursday's shootaround but doesn't have a timeline to return to game action, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Adem Bona
injuries.detail: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Drew Timme
injuries.detail: The Suns claimed Timme off waivers Monday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.

injuries.name: Ja Morant

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.detail: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.detail: Youngblood (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Timberwolves.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Tre Johnson
injuries.detail: Johnson (back) won't play in Sunday's game against Houston, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
